verdict.rationale: PostHog's first-party docs say you can use SQL throughout the platform, with SQL insights supporting SELECT/FROM/JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY over events, persons and sessions. The same SQL (HogQL) is also exposed through the /query API, the CLI and the MCP execute-sql tool, and warehouse sources can be joined into the same query. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-platform SQL querying of raw events; the only community mention concerns cohorts not accepting SQL, which is a different feature.
